Project

The Project view displays comprehensive information about a selected project, including its details, related transactions, and financial summary.

This view provides a complete overview of your project's current state and history, making it easy to track progress and monitor financial performance.

Available Actions

From this view, you can:

• Click the Edit button to modify project details such as name, description, or status

• View all transactions associated with the project, including income and expenses

• Attach and manage project-related documents and files

• Review the complete transaction history to understand how the project has evolved over time

Understanding Project Data

The project view consolidates all relevant information in one place, showing financial summaries, transaction lists, and any attached documents.

Use this view to get a quick snapshot of project performance or to drill down into specific transaction details.

To learn about creating and editing projects, see: Project — Edit
